short: RH from prime-sum lower bounds and character nonvanishing

lean.name: Formalism.RiemannHypothesisOfLowerBounds
lean.plain: RH from prime-sum lower bounds and character nonvanishing
lean.note: The proposed route to RH requires the difference between the smoothed zeta and character prime sums to be bounded below by $-Cx^{1/2+\varepsilon}$ for every nontrivial real character in a chosen family and each $\varepsilon>0$. The corresponding $L$-functions must have no common zero to the right of the critical line. The implication is outside the final dependency cone.
